10→11: Express 5 is now the default HTTP adapter
Express 5 routing: wildcards must be named — use '/*splat' or '/{*splat}' instead of '/*', and optional segments use braces '/:file{.:ext}' instead of the '?' suffix
CacheModule now uses cache-manager v6 (Keyv-based unified key-value interface)
Termination lifecycle hooks (OnModuleDestroy, OnApplicationShutdown, ...) now execute in reverse order
ConsoleLogger overhaul: built-in JSON logging, better formatting for nested objects/Maps/Sets, and customizable prefixes
